image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a dark, arched stone tunnel or corridor leading to a bright, barred gate. The walls are rough-hewn stone or brick, curving into an arch overhead. At the end of the tunnel is a tall, rectangular metal gate with vertical bars and a decorative arched top section containing glass panes or open lattice work. Light streams in from outside through the gate, creating high contrast.

No chain-link or palisade fencing is visible; the barrier is a solid metal gate.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the scene (tunnel + barred gate) is correctly classified as a prison/dungeon environment rather than a generic cellar or castle.
To ensure the linear perspective of the tunnel walls and floor converges correctly towards the gate without warping or melting.
To check for fusion artifacts where the vertical bars meet the frame or the ground, ensuring they are distinct, separate entities.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the metal gate bars (no bending/fusion)
Perspective consistency of the tunnel arch and floor tiles
Texture realism of the stone/brick walls (no smearing)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the gate bars with the floor and the archway. AI often struggles with thin, repetitive structures like bars, causing them to merge or waver. Also, verify that the light coming through the gate doesn't create unnatural halos or bleeding onto the interior walls.
